name: meet
description: Meet — production-grade WebRTC conferencing (SFU) for web and Android

scripts.build: npm run build -w @meet/protocol && npm run build -w @meet/client-core && npm run build -w @meet/server && npm run build -w @meet/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n proto,server,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @meet/protocol" "npm run dev -w @meet/server" "npm run dev -w @meet/web"
